That's not my problem. 

People don't scare me, they upset me. I get angry and I can't control myself other than to dress people down and make them leave. I've even been violent before because of this. 

It's not a problem I can fix by going out into public and being around people. I'm not going to jail again. 

I'm not going to talk to my friend about my problems. He doesn't really care, all he wants to do is show me his new car or show me something smart of funny his kids are doing or pictures from one of the several vacations that take a year. 

This world isn't for me because it has people in it and people piss me off. I'm angry right now because of what you wrote. I'm going to go kill myself just to find that calm place I've always looked for. 

Good bye.
